youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus, answered from Scripture.

Prayer for thanking God while still waiting.

She: Jesus... I thanked You in advance at church today. I felt fake. 🙏
She: Same prayer. Eleventh month. And I stood there saying thank You like it had already come.
Jesus: You weren't faking. You were trusting Me with nothing to see yet. That's the hard kind.
She: Thanking feels like lying when the door is still shut. What if it never opens, Jesus?
Jesus: Thanking Me early isn't saying the pain is gone. It's saying you believe I'm still listening.
Jesus: Keep thanking Me in the waiting. Not because it came, but because I'm still carrying it.

“In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.”
1 Thessalonians 5:18 (KJV)

Thanking early isn't pretending. It's trusting out loud.
